title: Example contradicting rule
text: Example contradicting rule: AC1 classifies an invalid model credential as a failure before changed files are read, but the existing flow detects an invalid credential only during the model request after `readChangedFiles`; the same AC later classifies model errors after that boundary under a different logging contract. Move invalid credentials to the post-boundary case or define a preflight validation mechanism so required sweep metadata is unambiguous.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 15dc014, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
